title: Research
subtitle: Feed it to learn
text:
The Research Station is a powered machine that eats resources. Choose a project with the arrows and feed it the items it asks for. When it is done, new world types and resources unlock for everyone on the server.

Mob research needs scans. Charge a Mob Scanner in a charger and use it on a mob. Each mob can only be scanned once.

Put a blank Jump Card in the card slot and press Imprint to program it with the chosen project.
